game.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag: Resynced
game.description: Absolutely loved this game and played the fuck out of the original. Super happy to be playing it with good graphics. Game is receiving sm hate but I think they're all just nitpicking too much, amazing game.

photos.caption: SWE internship at Dark Wolf Solutions for the summer! Excited to spend the time in DC, been missing it.
Day trip to Shenandoah with my lovely girlfriend!

Spent a good amount of the summer working on a website for the GW climbing club. Super happy with how it's turned out, doesn't look like much but there's a lot of backend work for the eboard that will hopefully last until after I graduate.
So happy for the school year to have started back up and to be climbing with friends again, missed this the most when I was abroad.
